fields.summary_ko.0: Broadcom (AVGO) stock declined following Rothschild analyst Mike Harrison's downgrade to neutral and price target reduction from $595 to $398 (approximately 10% upside).
fields.summary_ko.1: Harrison cited funding capacity challenges for AI startup customers like OpenAI and Anthropic, and intensified competition from in-house chip development by Alphabet and others as key weaknesses.
fields.summary_ko.2: Broadcom is providing credit guarantees of up to $63.0 billion for Anthropic and $50.0 billion for OpenAI, though at current P/E multiples below 18x, risks are already reflected.
